info.description: The footer: closing statement, credits, copyright line and repeated menu links.

description.description: The closing statement about the brand, shown at the top of the footer.

copyright.description: The copyright line, for example "@2026 Nota Team".

nav_links.description: Footer links, in display order. Usually the same links as the header.

credit_links.description: Bottom-bar credit attributions in display order (e.g. 'Made in Taptop', 'Designed by Alice'). Each can have an optional link.

made_in_logo.description: Small logo icon shown beside the 'Made in' credit. SVG or PNG, max 64px.
